## IMetricsPluginRegisterOptions.endpoint property

Endpoint to expose metrics in prometheus format. `null` - disables metrics exposure. An object may omit `method` and `handler`<!-- -->; they are always set to `GET` and the metrics handler.

**Signature:**

```typescript
endpoint: string | null | RouteOptions | (Omit<RouteOptions, 'method' | 'handler'> & Partial<Pick<RouteOptions, 'method' | 'handler'>>);
```

## Default Value

`/metrics`
